title: pt tax
description:
Realized gains by holding period with an estimated liability.

`disclaimer` is REQUIRED to be a non-empty string here, and `excludes_wash_sales` is required to be present. A tax report that quietly omitted either would be the silently-wrong-number failure mode by definition.

excludes_wash_sales.description: True until wash-sale detection lands in v0.2. A const, so that flipping it silently is impossible: the schema has to change too.

is_complete.description: False when a disposition was excluded from every total above because no cost basis for it can be derived (ADR 0017 §2b). Required, so an incomplete report cannot be read as a whole one — the same treatment `valuation_snapshot.is_complete` gives a snapshot built from a position that could not be priced.

approximate_basis.description: Cost basis inside the reported totals that did not come from this portfolio's own ledger.

approximate_basis_share.description: Proportion of reported cost basis resting on a non-derived lot. Measured on basis, not on gain: the basis is the approximate input, and a proportion of a signed total near zero misleads more than it informs. Null when nothing was reported — NOT zero, which would say every basis was exact.

basis_provenance.description: What rests on each rung of ADR 0017's ladder. A report where every basis is exact and one where a sixth is reconstructed must not look identical.

unreportable.description: Dispositions excluded from every total, listed with proceeds only. `cost_basis` and `gain` are REQUIRED to be null: the lot was seeded at cutover market value so cash conservation would close, and the difference between that and the proceeds is the change since an arbitrary date, not a gain. A zero would be read as a figure.
